dataSource.name: CG$Q_BRKR_MSTR
dataSource.select:
SELECT DISTINCT
I.TYP, I.LIC_NBR, I.LIC_TYPE, I.BRKR_NAME, I.PORT_CD, I.NEW_ID_NBR,
I.BUS_ID, I.BRNCH_BUS_ID,
I.ARBC_IMPR_NAME, I.IMP_PORT_CD
FROM
(SELECT DISTINCT ' '||IMP.ARBC_IMPR_NAME ARBC_IMPR_NAME, IMP.PORT_CD IMP_PORT_CD, C.BUS_ID, C.BRNCH_BUS_ID, C.TYP, C.LIC_NBR, C.LIC_TYPE, C.BRKR_NAME, C.PORT_CD, C.NEW_ID_NBR
FROM IMPORTERS IMP, ------------------------------------------------------ (SELECT DISTINCT B.TYP, B.LIC_NBR, B.LIC_TYPE, B.BRKR_NAME, B.PORT_CD, B.NEW_ID_NBR,
CIR.BUS_ID BUS_ID, CIR.BRNCH_BUS_ID BRNCH_BUS_ID FROM COMM_IMPR_RESPONSIBLES CIR, --COMM_IMPR_BUS_RESPONSIBLES CIR, ---------------------------------------------------------------- ( (SELECT DISTINCT 1 TYP, BKM.LIC_NBR LIC_NBR, BKM.LIC_TYPE LIC_TYPE, ' '||BKM.BRKR_NAME BRKR_NAME, BKM.PORT_CD, BKM.NEW_ID_NBR FROM BRKR_MSTR BKM WHERE (BKM.PORT_CD = :P_CURR_PORT_CD OR :P_CURR_PORT_CD IS NULL OR :P_CURR_PORT_CD = 99) AND (BKM.LIC_TYPE = :P_LIC_TYPE OR :P_LIC_TYPE IS NULL) ) UNION ALL (SELECT DISTINCT 2 , REP.REP_NBR, 0 , ' '||REP.REP_NAME, REP.PORT_CD, REP.NEW_ID_NBR FROM REPS REP WHERE (REP.PORT_CD = :P_CURR_PORT_CD OR :P_CURR_PORT_CD IS NULL OR :P_CURR_PORT_CD = 99) AND (:P_LIC_TYPE = 4 OR :P_LIC_TYPE IS NULL) ) ) B ---------------------------------------------------------------- WHERE -- (CIR.RESPONSIBLE_ID_CARD = 1013305519) and (CIR.RESPONSIBLE_ID_CARD LIKE B.NEW_ID_NBR) ) C ---------------------------------------------------------------- WHERE (IMP.BUS_ID = C.BUS_ID) AND ((IMP.BUS_ID_BRNCH LIKE C.BRNCH_BUS_ID) OR ((LTRIM(RTRIM(IMP.BUS_ID_BRNCH)) IS NULL OR LTRIM(RTRIM(IMP.BUS_ID_BRNCH)) = '0') AND (C.BRNCH_BUS_ID IS NULL OR C.BRNCH_BUS_ID = 0) ))
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 'X' FROM IMPR_SUSPNS IS_1 WHERE IS_1.PORT_CD = IMP.PORT_CD AND IS_1.IMPR_NBR = IMP.IMPR_NBR AND IS_1.SUSPN_STRT_DT <= HIJDATE_DB.Cur_Hij_Date AND IS_1.SUSPN_END_DT >= HIJDATE_DB.Cur_Hij_Date AND IS_1.SUSPN_RLSE_DT IS NULL) ) I ---------------------------------------------------------------- --ORDER BY 1 , 2 , 7 , 8 , 9 , 10
